devdoc.details: IMPORTANT: Must NOT declare any state variables. Storage layout must match VaultBase exactly.This contract's own storage is never used — delegatecall reads from the calling Vault's storage.

IndexOutOfBounds().details: The index must be less than the length.

NewOwnerIsZeroAddress().details: The `newOwner` cannot be the zero address.

NoHandoverRequest().details: The `pendingOwner` does not have a valid handover request.

Permit2AllowanceIsFixedAtInfinity().details: The allowance of Permit2 is fixed at infinity.

Unauthorized().details: The caller is not authorized to call the function.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` tokens is approved by `owner` to be used by `spender`.

OwnershipHandoverCanceled(address).details: The ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been canceled.

OwnershipHandoverRequested(address).details: An ownership handover to `pendingOwner` has been requested.

OwnershipTransferred(address,address).details: The ownership is transferred from `oldOwner` to `newOwner`. This event is intentionally kept the same as OpenZeppelin's Ownable to be compatible with indexers and [EIP-173](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-173), despite it not being as lightweight as a single argument event.

PausedStatusModified(address,uint256).details: This single event captures both pausing and unpausing actions.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `amount` tokens is transferred from `from` to `to`.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the EIP-712 domain separator for the EIP-2612 permit.

actionExecutableAt(bytes).details: A return value of zero indicates that the action is not queued in the timelock

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the amount of tokens that `spender` can spend on behalf of `owner`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens. Emits a {Approval} event.

asset().details: During delegatecall, `this` refers to the calling Vault. These external calls route back to the Vault's own bytecode, reading the correct immutable values.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the amount of tokens owned by `owner`.

cancelOwnershipHandover().details: Cancels the two-step ownership handover to the caller, if any.

cancelTimelockedAction(bytes).details: An `action` can be canceled whether or not its timelock delay has elapsed.Callable only by the contract owner.

completeOwnershipHandover(address).details: Function is overridden to enforce timelocking of ownership transfers.

convertToAssets(uint256).details: Returns the amount of assets that the Vault will exchange for the amount of shares provided, in an ideal scenario where all conditions are met. - MUST NOT be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller. - MUST NOT reflect slippage or other on-chain conditions, during the actual exchange. - MUST NOT revert. Note: This calculation MAY NOT reflect the "per-user" price-per-share, and instead should reflect the "average-user's" price-per-share, i.e. what the average user should expect to see when exchanging to and from.Uses a single "virtual share" to address the possibility of "inflation attacks". See https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/issues/3706 for context.

convertToShares(uint256).details: Returns the amount of shares that the Vault will exchange for the amount of assets provided, in an ideal scenario where all conditions are met. - MUST NOT be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller. - MUST NOT reflect slippage or other on-chain conditions, during the actual exchange. - MUST NOT revert. Note: This calculation MAY NOT reflect the "per-user" price-per-share, and instead should reflect the "average-user's" price-per-share, i.e. what the average user should expect to see when exchanging to and from.Uses a single "virtual share" to address the possibility of "inflation attacks". See https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/issues/3706 for context.

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

decreaseTimelockDelay(bytes4,uint256).details: Callable only by the contract owner.This will revert if the `newDelay` is not less than the existing delay.

epochEndTimestamp().details: Technically epoch rollover will happen on the first update at or after this timestamp.

increaseTimelockDelay(bytes4,uint256).details: Callable only by the contract owner.This will revert if the `newDelay` is not greater than the existing delay.

isNotPaused(uint256).details: Will return 'false' even if some but not all of the `flags` are not paused.

params.flags: Bitmap of pausing flags to check paused status against.

isPaused(uint256).details: Will return 'false' even if some but not all of the `flags` are paused.

params.flags: Bitmap of pausing flags to check paused status against.

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).details: This function enforces the same checks as `swap` above, except for checking for the actual swap results and emitting the `SwapLossRealized` event as that is not possible because this function is called before the swap happens.Uses solady's ECDSA::recover function which doesn't check for sig malleability. This is fine as we are only using the signature to recover the signer, and not as a unique identifier for anything. Also works for the newer EIP-2098 signatures

params.data: The data array of the relevant order params, as well as the signature of the curator.

returns.magicValue: `0x1626ba7e` if the signer is an allocator, `0xffffffff` otherwise.

managementFeeAccrualBaseE18().details: Stored in this manner to support automatic compounding of fees, so that the amount of shares minted as management fees is ~independent of how often `_accrueManagementFees()` is invoked.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value is used to compute the signature for EIP-2612 permit.

owner().details: Returns the owner of the contract.

ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address).details: Returns the expiry timestamp for the two-step ownership handover to `pendingOwner`.

performRestrictedExternalCall(address,by.details: Useful for claiming incentives earned by the vault

performanceFeeDebt().details: This debt is reduced prior to incrementing `provisionalShares`.At epoch rollover, `performanceFeeDebt` is zeroed out.Non-zero `performanceFeeDebt` and non-zero `provisionalShares` should *never* coexist simultaneously.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over the tokens of `owner`, authorized by a signed approval by `owner`. Emits a {Approval} event.

params.positionId: The UniV4 position ID of the liquidity position.

returns.value: The value of this specific position denominated in asset.

provisionalShares().details: Before the end of the epoch, these virtual shares will be burnt to cover a share (equal to `performanceFeeE6 / FACTOR_E6`) of any intra-epoch losses.On epoch rollover, existing `provisionalShares` are converted to real shares owned by the `performanceFeeRecipient`.

queueTimelockedAction(bytes).details: Callable only by the contract owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Allows the owner to renounce their ownership.

requestOwnershipHandover().details: Request a two-step ownership handover to the caller. The request will automatically expire in 48 hours (172800 seconds) by default.

setTransferPolicy(address).details: Setting transferPolicy to `address(0)` is explicitly *allowed*; in this case, no transfer restrictions will be enforced.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token.

totalAssets().details: Pending deposits have already been received by this contract but are excluded from total assets      because no shares have been issued for them yetReturns the total amount of the underlying asset managed by the Vault. - SHOULD include any compounding that occurs from the yield. - MUST be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT revert.

totalSharesIncludingProvisional().details: Provisional shares dilute increases in exchange rate, and are burnt to dilute decreases in exchange rate.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Transfer `amount` tokens from the caller to `to`. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `amount` tokens from `from` to `to`. Note: Does not update the allowance if it is the maximum uint256 value. Requirements: - `from` must at least have `amount`. - The caller must have at least `amount` of allowance to transfer the tokens of `from`. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Function is overridden to enforce timelocking of ownership transfers.

PausedStatusModified(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when the `caller` causes the `pausedStatus` to be set to `newPausedStatus`

ANGSTROM_VAULT_FACTORY().notice: Factory contract which deployed this contract.

accrueFees().notice: Permissionless function to update the `provisionalShares` value to reflect crossing an epoch boundary and/or a change in the exchange rate of shares to assets, and calculate + distribute management fees.

actionExecutableAt(bytes).notice: Mapping: action => UTC timestamp at which the action becomes executable

approveIntentsRouter(address,uint256).notice: Approves the intents router with ERC20 approval, for use with intents based swaps. If integrating with CoWSwap, this should be GPv2VaultRelay and NOT GPv2Settlement.

cancelIntentsOrders(address,bytes[]).notice: Attempts to cancel intents orders on-chain. However there is a possibility of race condition between the CoWSwap solvers and the cancelation order. The solver might fill the order before the cancelation tx is confirmed, resulting in a failed cancelation.

cancelTimelockedAction(bytes).notice: Cancels an `action` that was previously queued via `_queueTimelockedAction()`.

convertCurrencyToAsset(address,uint256).notice: Converts the `amount` of `currency` to an equivalent amount of the `asset` of this vault

convertLiquidityPositionsToConstituentTo.notice: Calculates the total amount of tokens in all of this vault's currently held Angstrom Liquidity Positions

decreaseTimelockDelay(bytes4,uint256).notice: Decreases the timelock delay for the function corresponding to `functionSelector`, setting it to `newDelay`.

epochEndTimestamp().notice: Timestamp at which the current epoch ends.

epochLengthSeconds().notice: Length of epoch for performance calculations.

exchangeRateE36Last().notice: Exchange rate of 1e36 shares to assets, at the last fee update, i.e. the last invocation of `accrueFees()`, indicated by `managementFeesAccruedUntil`.

increaseTimelockDelay(bytes4,uint256).notice: Increases the timelock delay for the function corresponding to `functionSelector`, setting it to `newDelay`.

intentsRouter().notice: Address of the intents based swap router, approved to spend vault tokens.

isAllocator(address).notice: Mapping: address => whether the account has the Allocator role or not.

isNotPaused(uint256).notice: Returns whether or not *all* of `flags` are not paused.

isPaused(uint256).notice: Returns whether or not *all* of `flags` are paused.

isPauser(address).notice: Mapping: address => whether the account has the Pauser role or not.

isTimelockCanceler(address).notice: Mapping: address => whether the account has the TimelockCanceler role or not.

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).notice: ERC1271 signature validation. Recovers the signer and checks if they are an allocator. Meant to be used with intent based swap routers such as CoWSwap.

managementFeeAccrualBaseE18().notice: One plus the fraction of total assets that should accrue from management fees every second, scaled by

managementFeeProtocolFractionE6().notice: Share of newly-minted management fee shares that go to the `ANGSTROM_VAULT_FACTORY`.

managementFeeRecipient().notice: Address to receive collected management fees.

managementFeesAccruedUntil().notice: UTC timestamp at which management fees were last accrued.

pausedStatus().notice: 256-slot bitmap representing the paused status of this contract.

performRestrictedExternalCall(address,by.notice: Allows an allocator to perform an external call, as long as neither the `target` nor the 4-byte         function signature at the start of `callContents` is disallowed

performanceFeeDebt().notice: Virtual debt issued for share of intra-epoch losses (equal to `performanceFeeE6 / FACTOR_E6`) that cannot be covered by `provisionalShares`.

performanceFeeE6().notice: Performance fee charged on vault performance, in parts per million.

performanceFeeProtocolFractionE6().notice: Share of newly-minted performance fee shares that go to the `ANGSTROM_VAULT_FACTORY`.

performanceFeeRecipient().notice: Address to receive collected performance fees.

perpsOracle().notice: Oracle used to report perps value in the vault asset.

perpsWallet().notice: Address used for external perps collateral custody.

priceOracle().notice: Oracle used for converting token amounts into `asset` amounts.

provisionalShares().notice: Virtual shares issued for potentially paying performance fees.

queueTimelockedAction(bytes).notice: Queues an `action` to be executed after the timelock delay.

timelockDelay(bytes4).notice: Mapping: function selector => timelock delay in seconds

totalAssets().notice: Returns the present value -- in the `asset` of the holdings presently managed by this vault

totalSharesIncludingProvisional().notice: Returns the totalSupply of issued shares plus any `provisionalShares`

transferPolicy().notice: Contract used to restrict deposits, redemptions, or share transfers.

vestibule().notice: Per-vault escrow/request contract for async deposits and redemptions.

userdoc.notice: Singleton extension contract shared by all Vaults. Called via delegatecall from Vault's fallback function. Contains admin setters, timelock admin, pause functions, and view/getter functions.
